scope: Two frozen single-cycle1T1R SET conditional checks; no fit, holdout, RESET,32-cycle history or completed1R/1T1R model.
state_law: du/ds=-k*max(log(I_T(A,u)/JS)+beta*u,0); Gamma=gc/expm1(u); I_T from series KCL
backward_initialization: Integrate the same signed du/dA from A=.2 down to0. At exactly zero command,I=0 and drive=0. No freezing0->.2.
forward: Outward path s:0->5,A=s; return s:5->10,A=10-s. Continue state at apex; duplicated native endpoints do not add dwell.
domain_policy: No state projection. Gamma and every positive material voltage must remain inside existing table support; zero voltage is the exact passive endpoint. Stop and preserve any domain failure.
rate_selection: Exactly the two specified rates, no adaptive seeds,rate scans,initial-state changes or optimization.
KCL_method: Scalar brentq in transistor-drop voltage; compare to original42-step material-voltage bisection before any ODE. On comparison failure use original42-step method.
scoring: Every original cycle4 SET point with V!=0,finite absI>=1e-11; raw log10 residuals, no floor replacement or low-bias exclusion.
feature_scope: Single-cycle predictions beside original32-record aggregate bands for context only; no aggregate gate-passing claim.
budget_start: After all input loads and hashes, but before KCL comparison and every ODE. Timeout stops all remaining work and retains completed segments/runs.
numerical_refinement: Preserve the two completed precision trajectories; recover only beta4 nominal and beta6 refined. Each recovered precision independently repeats backward initialization at the same fixed anchor. Six total solver attempts, only two physical seeds.
stop_policy: All failures retained; timeout forbids restart or extensions.

numerical_interface_correction.correction: Use original log-voltage bounds so log(5) is accepted at the table endpoint despite exp(log(5)) rounding below5. Bound transistor drop independently and require a bracketed KCL root; no extrapolation.
numerical_interface_correction.low_voltage_resolution_policy: A positive local voltage below table minimum is numerical_unknown, not evidence of physical candidate failure.

inactive_endpoint_recovery.proof: For0<A<vmin:0<=I_T(A,u)<=F(A,u)<=F(vmin,u). If log(F(vmin,u)/JS)+beta*u<=0, the physical positive-part rate is exactly0. Do not assign an out-of-domain current or clamp A/u. If this upper bound is positive, retain numerical_unknown.
